name: Claude Design
desc: Claude that turns a described visual into an on-brand draft
desc_zh: 按文字描述生成合乎品牌规范设计初稿的 Claude
solves: A deck or poster needs a visual and the design queue is a week out; Claude Design drafts a first version now.
solves_zh: 演示或海报缺一张图，设计排期要等一周，Claude Design 先出初稿。
best_for: You need a campaign visual for tomorrow's stand-up and only have a one-line idea.
best_for_zh: 明天的站会要一张活动配图，手头只有一句创意描述。
